summary: Structure, files, ontology and design are sound, but comment[ms1 scan range] 400-1600 m/z (from paper text) contradicts the deposited RAW files, which were acquired at 400-1400 m/z.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; no producer transcript, report.md or prior reviews read; evidence limited to the dataset's scratchpad folder plus re-fetched PRIDE/Europe PMC/OLS/Cellosaurus and RAW-header byte ranges

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates ms-proteomics + human + cell-lines v1.1.0 declared and appropriate for SW480; validator accepts columns/order; only free-text treatment warnings.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check 14/14 verified; OLS exact: colon adenocarcinoma MONDO:0002271, colon UBERON:0001155, epithelial cell CL:0000066; Cellosaurus CVCL_0546 = SW480, Male, 51Y, NCIt C4349 colon adenocarcinoma; Q Exactive HF MS:1002523.

source_evidence.evidence: RAW header byte ranges of con1_cyt1, con1_cyt2, VH3b1_cyt1, gefitinib3_cyt2 all show 'Method of Q Exactive HF', 'Scan range 400 to 1400 m/z', TopN 6, NCE 27, dynamic exclusion 45 s; paper/PRIDE text says 400-1600 m/z, top10, 15 s. SDRF ms1 scan range copies the text, not the acquisition. Other values (DTT/IAA, trypsin, 20 ppm/0.01 Da, Carbamidomethyl/Oxidation, Cellosaurus sex/age) supported.

file_mapping.evidence: files.json (projectAccessions==PXD033149): 18 RAW; SDRF 18 unique data files, symmetric difference empty; mzML/mzid.gz correctly excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: 3 conditions x 3 biological replicates x 2 runs (cyt1/cyt2 -> technical replicate 1/2) = 18, matching paper 'n = 18' LC runs and 'first LC-runs ... for all replications'; source names unique per biological sample; factor value[treatment] matches characteristics[treatment].

omission_safety.evidence: Age 51Y/male/adult from Cellosaurus; disease from Cellosaurus NCIt; no unsupported additions found beyond the scan-range error (recorded under source evidence). Treatment dose choice documented in manifest limitations.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t cell-lines: warnings only (3 free-text treatment terms), exit 0; sdrf-tools check CLEAN exit 0; score 98/100 exit 0.

findings.message: Value 400m/z-1600m/z contradicts the deposited RAW instrument method (400 to 1400 m/z).
findings.evidence: UTF-16 method text in first 4 MB of 4 of 18 RAW files (all three conditions, cyt1 and cyt2): 'Scan range 400 to 1400 m/z'. Correction: set 400m/z-1400m/z (RAW is authoritative over the paper text, which also misstates top10/15 s vs RAW top6/45 s).

findings.message: Dose/time 10 nM 1 h is taken from the proteomics sample-prep text, while the paper also says 'The IC50 of testing samples was used in the proteomics analysis' (527 nM / 13.31 uM).
findings.evidence: manuscript.txt Methods lines 21 and 23; ambiguity is documented in the manifest limitations; acceptable, but the RAW/paper method mismatch weakens the paper text as a source for acquisition details.

findings.message: cyt1/cyt2 as repeated injections is inferred from file names.
findings.evidence: Supported by n = 18 runs for 9 samples and identical RAW methods for cyt1/cyt2; lysis protocol describes a single supernatant, so no subcellular-fraction split is evident.
